verdict.rationale: Algolia ships an official CLI explicitly documented for scripts and CI workflows, plus REST APIs and official language clients usable headlessly, and this was runtime-verified to work keylessly via npx. Data ingestion (Crawler, integrations) and search can all run without a UI, supporting automation pipelines. Missing for 10: no first-party CI recipe/example (e.g. GitHub Actions template) or independent case study of the CLI used in a CI pipeline.
